subject: Package marked delivered
body:
My order is still marked as delivered.
I checked the porch and mailroom.
answer:
Please confirm the delivery address.

If it is correct, allow one business day and contact us again.

subject: Password reset link expired
body: The reset email arrived after the link expired.

subject: Return label request
body: I need a return label for the shoes I ordered.
answer: A return label is available in your order details.

subject: Receipt has the wrong billing address
body: The receipt shows my old billing address.
answer: Update the billing profile and download a new receipt.

subject: Mobile app closes on launch
body: The app closes as soon as I open it after yesterday's update.
answer: Restart the device and install any available app update.

subject: Unable to apply discount code
body: The checkout page says this code is not valid.
answer: Check the offer terms and confirm the cart meets its minimum value.

subject: Order confirmation not received
body: I placed the order but there is no confirmation in my inbox.
answer: Check your spam folder and verify the email address on the account.

subject: Account is locked
body: Too many sign-in attempts locked my account.
answer: Wait for the lockout period to end, then request a password reset.

subject: Tracking page has not changed
body: The carrier tracking page has shown the same scan for three days.
answer: Allow time for the next carrier scan. Contact support if delivery is delayed beyond the estimate.

subject: App language setting
body: How can I change the app language to Español?
answer: Open Settings, choose Language, and select Español.
